title: Cebu-based graduate tops November 2026 Chemical Engineer licensure exam
summary: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A Cebu-based graduate led thousands of aspiring chemical engineers nationwide after securing the highest score in the November 2026 Chemical Engineer Licensure Examination…

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A Cebu-based graduate led thousands of aspiring chemical engineers nationwide after securing the highest score in the November 2026 Chemical Engineer Licensure Examination (CHELE), the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced. Timothy John Alcantara Jala of the University of San Carlos (USC) topped the examination with a rating of 93.30 percent. He placed ahead of 16 other examinees who secured spots in the top 10. The PRC reported that 814 of the 955 examinees passed the computer-based licensure examination. That pointed to an overall passing rate of 85.24 percent.
